CREATE VIEW bronze.vw_USOnTimeData_CSV
AS

SELECT
    result.filepath(1) AS year,
    result.filepath(2) AS month,
    result.* 
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '/*/*/*.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Reporting',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )
    WITH
    (
        FL_DATE DATE,
        OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID INT,
        TAIL_NUM VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        ORIGIN VARCHAR(10),
        ORIGIN_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        ORIGIN_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        DEST_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        DEST VARCHAR(10),
        DEST_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        DEST_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        CRS_DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_DELAY FLOAT,
        DEP_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        TAXI_OUT FLOAT,
        WHEELS_ON INT,
        TAXI_IN FLOAT,
        CRS_ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_DELAY FLOAT,
        ARR_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        CANCELLED FLOAT,
        CANCELLATION_CODE VARCHAR(5),
        DIVERTED FLOAT,
        CRS_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        AIR_TIME FLOAT,
        DISTANCE FLOAT,
        CARRIER_DELAY FLOAT,
        WEATHER_DELAY FLOAT,
        NAS_DELAY FLOAT,
        SECURITY_DELAY FLOAT,
        LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY FLOAT
    ) as result


    select count(1) from bronze.vw_USOnTimeData_CSV

    select top 10 * from bronze.vw_USOnTimeData_CSV WHERE year = '2022' AND month ='01'
